scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @crm/api" "npm run dev -w @crm/web"
scripts.test:stage1: npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run test:integration -w @crm/api
scripts.admin:create: npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run admin:create -w @crm/api
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run test:browser -w @crm/web
scripts.test:stage3: npm run build -w @crm/api && node --test apps/api/tests/pricing.unit.cjs apps/api/tests/stage3.acceptance.cjs
scripts.test:stage4: npm run build -w @crm/api && node --test apps/api/tests/availability.unit.cjs apps/api/tests/stage4.acceptance.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build -w @crm/api && node scripts/run-tests.cjs all
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @crm/api && node scripts/run-tests.cjs api
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @crm/api && node scripts/run-tests.cjs web
